exposure: Repeated doses of dinoprostone vaginal insert for labor induction
cohort: 1,043 pregnant women who received dinoprostone for labor induction between November 2012 and August 2015
finding: Repeated-dose dinoprostone for labor induction, when the first dose fails, is associated with increased cesarean section rates and adverse neonatal outcomes compared to a single dose.
mod_finding: Repeated doses of dinoprostone for labor induction were associated with increased cesarean section rates compared to a single dose.
